messages:
Lana: Hey design — we need a compact "pocket guide" visual for the upcoming benchmark/webinar launch. Think one-sheet + 4 social tiles + a hero slide. Need art direction and export-ready files.
Anya: Can you outline the exact pieces and sizes you want?
Lana: Main deliverables: hero slide (16:9, 1920x1080), one-pager PDF (A4 2480x3508 @300dpi), social tiles 1080x1080 (x4 variants), long social 1200x628, and a small infographic (600x900) for the latency vs cost sparkline. Also a tiny decision flow diagram (800x600) for Hosted vs Dedicated.
Morgan: Style direction? flat/realistic/illustrated?
Lana: Flat with subtle gradients and clean iconography. Use brand palette v2 (navy, teal, sunrise accents). Avoid heavy shadows. Keep it friendly but technical.
Design-ops: Brand note — logo needs 16px clearspace, don't place on gradients unless approved. Add dark/light variants and include alt logo placement. I'll drop the brand kit.
Anya: Timeline? can we get roughs and then final exports?
Lana: Roughs in 3 business days, finals 2 business days after copy lock. Webinar hero + 3 supporting slides are highest priority.
Devon: Copy for the hero and social? short versions for ads?
Lana: Hero headline: "Make inference predictable." Subhead: "Benchmark-backed ways to lower per-token cost without sacrificing quality." CTA: "Register — Oct 5" Short ad headline (<=90 chars): "Cut inference costs, keep latency low" Body (<=160 chars): "Join our Oct 5 webinar: actionable benchmarks and tradeoffs for serving LLMs."
Morgan: For the small decision flow, should we call out quantization & autoscaling recommendations?
Lana: Yes — have micro-badges: "quantized", "fp16", "autoscale" with one-line notes. Keep badges simple outline icons (mono).
Design-ops: Export checklist: provide source Figma file, PNG@2x for socials, SVG for diagrams, PDF for print A4. Name frames like: hero_launch, social_01, social_02, onepager_v1.
Sam-bot: Uploaded template and asset-checklist: https://figma.com/file/abcd-pocket-guide-template
Anya: I'll schedule a 30m review tomorrow 10:00am PT to go over roughs. Please RSVP.
Lana: Quick ask — the latency vs cost sparkline needs an annotation showing a crossover point where batching -> reduces cost but increases latency. Keep the chart minimalist.
Morgan: Got it. Would you prefer numeric callouts or percentage labels?
Lana: Percentage labels (e.g., "-35% cost") with tiny callout arrow.
Devon: Any photography or is this 100% illustrated?
Lana: 100% illustrated for consistency. Use simple people silhouettes if needed.
Design-ops: I'll attach the brand tokens and a small doc with do/don't examples.
Anya: 👍 I'll collect the final copy into the doc before the review.
Lana: Thanks team — ping me immediately if blocked on brand access or Figma. :rocket:
